name: TECHSTORE
recent: 最多占已发行股本 10%。董事经理 Tan Hock Lim 在 8 月底至 9 月初多次增持公司股份。公司已于 8 月 24 日公布截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度的业绩。
notable: 董事经理 Tan Hock Lim 于 2026 年 8 月 26 日及 9 月 3 日多次增持公司股份。
risks: ESOS 最多可发行相当于已发行股本 10% 的新股，可能造成股权摊薄。

recent_en: TechStore has proposed an employees' share option scheme (ESOS) of up to 10% of its issued share capital. Managing Director Tan Hock Lim acquired shares several times between late August and early September. The company released its quarterly results for the period ended 30 June 2026 on 24 August.
notable_en: Proposed establishment of an employees' share option scheme (ESOS) of up to 10% of issued share capital.
Managing Director Tan Hock Lim acquired shares multiple times on 26 August and 3 September 2026.
risks_en: The ESOS may involve issuance of new shares of up to 10% of issued share capital, potentially causing dilution.
